versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides practical assistance for self-improving, agent-style workflows in work productivity contexts.
- Offers reusable checklists, workflows, and decision aids to help fix bugs, improve reliability, harden setup, and support adjacent skill creation.
- Focuses on local-hardware-friendly solutions (scripts, templates, CPU-safe workflows).
- Includes validation steps and next-step notes to ensure actionable outputs.
- Triggered by common work-productivity and self-improvement keywords and user requests.

- Initial public release of the Work Productivity Self Improving Workflow Helper skill.
- Provides practical support for agent-style, self-improving workflows with a focus on reliability, local hardware compatibility, and repeatability.
- Outputs include tailored work plans, reusable checklists, implementation support, and verification notes based on strong, validated user demand.
- Responds to keywords and trigger phrases related to work productivity, self-improvement, bug fixing, and workflow creation for agent users.
